description: On the table in front of you there’s a small green rectangular device with a red nub on one end, and a red-handled screwdriver lying nearby. The right hand reaches toward the screwdriver and lifts it, while the left hand slides in to pick up the green device; then the right hand brings the screwdriver tip to the red end of the green device and pushes it in and out slightly as if inserting and removing a small piece, with the green device staying as a left-hand object and the screwdriver as a right-hand object.
